title: bg-changer-MODELIA
description: Replaces a photo's background with a colour or an image: BiRefNet segmentation, clean edges and real shadows. CLI, FastAPI API and Next.js page, benchmarked on 970 images.

title: SMA — Multi-Agent Prospecting
description: LangGraph pipeline where specialised agents find companies, their key contacts and evidence-backed emails, traced node by node and scored with an LLM-as-judge in LangSmith.

title: AI Gateway — LLM Security
description: Gateway for cloud LLMs: personal data is anonymised before the call and restored in the answer, with prompt-injection and toxicity guardrails and an audit dashboard.

title: MLOps Platform
description: End-to-end MLOps platform covering training, deployment, monitoring, drift detection and A/B testing of ML models, with CI/CD.

title: Live Quiz Platform
description: Real-time quiz platform in the style of Mentimeter and Kahoot, with AI quiz generation and live sync between a host app and a participant app.

title: Scientific Publications Platform
description: Microservices platform for researchers: publication management, semantic search over PDFs and personalised recommendations, with an integrated LLM.

title: Job Match
description: Scrapes thousands of job offers and matches them to a CV with a local LLM, so personal data never leaves the machine.

title: Odyssee Travel Services
description: Landing page and offer-management dashboard for a travel agency, with analytics, maps and a documented REST API.

title: IoT Facial Recognition Security
description: Real-time intruder detection with MTCNN and FaceNet, DBSCAN grouping of unknown faces and a Flask and MongoDB API for the mobile app.

title: WeLearn Training Center
description: Training-centre platform with course management, automated PDF certificates, email notifications and an analytics dashboard.

title: Maze Generator & Solver
description: Procedural maze generation by recursive division, combined with word-based pathfinding solved with Dijkstra's algorithm.

title: Exam Supervision Scheduling
description: Desktop app that builds fair, rule-compliant exam supervision schedules in seconds with constraint programming.
